content.text: No exclusivity or sole-source language exists anywhere in the agreement. The only "exclusive" references are a non-exclusive licence grant to us, a non-exclusive escrow source-code licence to us, an exclusive-remedy limitation, and non-exclusive jurisdiction — none of which restrict our sourcing freedom.

input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity, sole-supplier or minimum-requirements obligation on Sparkling, so the rule's preferred position is satisfied. We reviewed the grant (§2), the restrictions on use (§3, which are limited to copying, assignment/sublicensing, reverse engineering and scope-of-use controls and contain no sourcing restriction), maintenance and support (§10, including Software Repair Service, which does not bar third-party maintenance), fees (§11) and the general provisions (§20), and searched for "exclusive", "sole", requirements/procurement and non-compete formulations. The only uses of "exclusive" run in our favour or are unrelated: the licence to us is "non-exclusive" (p0028), the escrow source-code licence to us is "non-exclusive" (p0115), §15 concerns exclusive remedies, and §20(h) provides non-exclusive jurisdiction. §19 is a mutual employee non-solicit, not an exclusive-dealing covenant. No redline is required and the fallback narrowing mechanics (defined category, 12-month cap, service-level and delivery-date exits) are unnecessary because there is nothing to narrow.
